keys.description: Listen port; the compose network reaches it as http://laya:8400.
A local checkpoint dir (volume-mounted, e.g. /checkpoint) or an HF repo id. Unset = the service refuses to start: a decision service with no head is a broken deployment, not a degraded one (P14).
Min P(decision) for a window to become a candidate.
Max candidates returned per scan, best-first.

checkpoint.description: The trained laya head this deployment serves (kg-v03 or successor).
checkpoint.when_unconfigured: The service fails fast at boot — intentionally, so a headless laya container is loud in `docker ps`, not silently useless behind a green /health on another service.
